title: TRUST IN
THE LORD
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: golden sun rays through forest trees
peaceful horizon at early morning light
golden hour over quiet valley landscape
sunlight breaking over calm ocean horizon
soft morning mist resting on green hills
gentle dawn glow illuminating quiet nature

scenes.a: As the first gentle light breaks across the quiet horizon, take a deep, steady breath and quiet your heart.
Heavenly Father, as this morning sun rises to greet the earth, we lift our thoughts to You above.
Your word reminds us to trust in the Lord with all our heart and lean not on our own understanding.
In all our ways we acknowledge You, knowing You will make our paths straight and steady.
Remove every anxious thought from our minds as we step forward into this brand new day.
Guide our hands, protect our steps, and fill our souls with Your enduring, profound peace.
May Your grace surround us from this sunrise until the evening shadows begin to fall.
In Jesus' name we pray, Amen. Subscribe to The Morning Altar for your daily sunrise prayer.
